name: floorboss
description: Book meetings at an event: sort the attendee list, research who to meet, draft short messages and follow-ups, and open each approved email in your own mail app for you to send. Auto-send, if you turn it on for an event, uses Gmail: either your laptop sends the first emails and saves the follow-ups as labelled Gmail drafts that a daily ChatGPT scheduled task sends when due, or your own ChatGPT cloud task sends them all.
